content.text: [Wed 2026-05-20 12:40 UTC] Locate the storage path for the CRM database files.
[Wed 2026-05-20 12:40 UTC] Mount the attached external USB drive to the /mnt/usb directory.

arguments.command: lsblk -o NAME,FSTYPE,SIZE,MOUNTPOINT,LABEL; mkdir -p /mnt/usb; find / -type f \( -name "*crm*" -o -name "*CRM*" \) -path "*db*" 2>/dev/null; find / -type d -name "*crm*" 2>/dev/null
